articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions, announced today that it will participate in the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Conference participation will be in-person and include a QA session to discuss dynamics across the various markets PHINIA serves around the world and the Company’s business. PHINIA’s President and CEO, Brady Ericson, and Senior VP and ​CFO, Chris Gropp, will participate in investor meetings and a fireside chat moderated by Jeff Lick, managing director and research analyst at Stephens. The event will be webcast and available on PHINIA’s Investor Relations website . Event information can be found below. articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems and aftermarket solutions, announced today the appointment of Gordon Muir as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective January 1, 2027. Muir succeeds Chris Gropp, current SVP and CFO, who will retire, effective March 31, 2027. Gropp will support the transition period starting January 1 through March 31, 2027, as Special Advisor, also reporting to Brady Ericson, President and Chief Executive Officer, focusing on a smooth and well-coordinated transition of responsibilities. “Gordon played a critical role in PHINIA becoming an independent company in 2023 and has continued to be an important part of our success. articles.summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend in the amount of $0.30 per common share, payable on December 11, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 23, 2026. About PHINIA PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI ® , DELCO REMY ® , HARTRIDGE™ and stoba ® . With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 13,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 21 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.
